create_config_tg_training: create a TransformerGrammars training config with stack-compose attention masks and Adam optimizer
build_config_debug_mode: build a debug training config by calling get_config with debug=True for smaller model dimensions
configure_model_attention: configure TransformerGrammars model with extra attention mask kwargs for stack-compose double closing non-terminal
setup_training_dataset: setup PreEncodedTextDataset config with training CSV filename and bos/eos token settings
configure_lr_schedule: configure linear warmup then cosine anneal learning rate schedule with 8000 warmup steps
